_comment: COPY ME to config.local.json (git-ignored) and edit. Everything here deep-merges ON TOP of config.default.json: dict entries override/add by key, list entries are added to the defaults, scalars replace. You only need the keys you want to change -- delete the rest. The values below are illustrative samples, not real services.
_dashboard_comment: Change the port the dashboard serves on, and the friendly name it gives its own row. access.allow_logins lets extra Tailscale logins (another person's account) load the page; your own devices are already allowed.
_port_labels_comment: port number (as a string) -> friendly name shown on the card.
_pinned_ports_comment: Ports you always want surfaced in the focused list, even on a high/dynamic number.
_user_facing_terms_comment: Substrings that force a service into the focused list when matched in its name/service/image/title.
_process_labels_comment: process image name (lowercase .exe) -> what the app actually is. Fills the gap for services on dynamic ports.
_process_label_prefixes_comment: image-name prefix -> label, for families of executables.
_background_process_images_comment: image names to push into the collapsed Background/System sections.
_diagnostics_comment: Which health-check panels to render. 'tailscale' is a built-in generic check. Other names (like 'example' below, or your own custom checks) must be provided by a local plugin: copy local_dev_tools/diagnostics_local.example.py to local_dev_tools/diagnostics_local.py (git-ignored) and define them. A check only runs when its name is enabled here.
_process_cleanup_comment: Extra substrings the process-cleanup tool treats as 'AI/tool' processes worth surfacing.
